heading: Cookies, only with your OK
text: We’d like to measure how the site is used. Nothing is set unless you say yes, and you can change your mind at the bottom of any page.
necessaryText: Keep the site working and remember your choice. These can’t be turned off.
preferencesText: Remember your settings on the site.
statisticsText: Show us how many people visit and what they read.
marketingText: Show us whether our ads bring people to the site.
targetingText: Let advertisers use your visit to show you our ads elsewhere.
